patch_description: The current circuit uses two distinct circuit angles, producing four total trainable parameters after gain and bias, while the strongest prior result used only one circuit angle. The proposed ansatz returns to one distinct circuit parameter and therefore three total parameters. It retains the successful collective RY mixer, fixed Möbius CZ graph, and shared nearest-neighbour ZZ layer, then adds dataset-aligned CRZ gates on the fixed readout pairs. These CRZ gates reuse the same collective angle, adding targeted control over the correlations ultimately measured without increasing parameter count. This stronger structural bias should improve worst-group separation and few-shot generalization while avoiding the extra local parameter and tied terminal RZ layer that reduced the current score. Fixed Adam settings—learning rate 0.03, 1000 epochs, 30 steps per epoch, batch size 15, validation-loss selection, and patience 75—remain unchanged as required.
